title: Where each ActiveSync class is kept
alt: Phones and Outlook talk ActiveSync to Hearth Mail. Mail goes to Hearth Mail's own store through the same code JMAP uses. Calendars, contacts, tasks and notes go through the DAV bridge to Nextcloud over CalDAV and CardDAV with the person's app password; Hearth can take Nextcloud's place later.
